title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1 TEK ''ZGJERIMI I REZIDENCES KODRA E DIELLIT 1'' !
description_sq:

• Orientimi i Apartamentit eshte Jug - Perendim. Prona disponon Certifikate Pronesie. Pronari disponon dhe 1 Post Parkimi ne katin -1 te mare me qira nga Rezidenca. Cmimi i Apartamentit eshte 185,000€ i negociueshëm. Per nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni !
Apartamenti eshte dhene me qira 700€ / muaj neto, me kontrat 1 vjeçare deri ne 01 Shtator 2026. Kusht per bleresin eshte qe te respektohet kontrata aktuale e qira
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE AT "KODRA E DIELLI 1 RESIDENCE EXPANSION"!
description_en: • 2+1 Apartment for sale in Kodra e Diellit Residence Extension 1, on the 2nd floor of a new building equipped with an elevator. The apartment has a total area of ​​76.8m2 and is organized in a distribution corridor, living room + kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony. • The orientation of the Apartment is South - West. The property has Ownership Certificates. The owner also has 1 Parking Post on the -1st floor rented from the Residence. The price of the Apartment is €185,000, negotiable. For a visit to the property, contact me! The apartment is rented for €700/month net, with a 1-year contract until September 1, 2026. The condition for the buyer is to respect the current rental contract.
